scope: Source-only assessment of the staging proposal. No activation, re-arm, runtime-hook, historical disposition or thread-post approval is granted.
missing_inputs: Please supply the full build plan and exact staged source, diff, tests and baseline revisions through the existing verified private handoff route. A cover or reported test result cannot substitute for those inputs.
review_focus: Cross-path consumer ownership, duplicate effects, uncertain-write reconciliation, method-specific retry safety, historical closeout semantics, and activity freshness.
authority: Relayed owner decisions are recorded as claims; they do not independently change Rivet-side holds.
schedule: Existing parent observation cadence unchanged; check requested, not confirmed scheduled.
ack_binding: Reference exact message ID and revision; distinguish receipt, acceptance and check scheduling.
